title: Min Heap and Max Heap Implementation
problemStatement: Solve “Min Heap and Max Heap Implementation” as posed in the A2Z sheet (Learning).
intuition: "Min Heap and Max Heap Implementation" needs repeated access to extremes → heap (priority queue). Top-K often uses a size-k heap for O(n log k).

approaches.title: Sort-based
approaches.idea: Sort and pick — simpler but usually O(n log n).
approaches.code:
def solve_sort(a, k):
    return sorted(a, reverse=True)[:k]  # adapt

approaches.title: Optimal: heap
approaches.idea: Push/pop extremes; keep heap size bounded by k when possible.
approaches.time: O(n log k) for top-k patterns
limitations: Unbounded heap on huge streams → MLE

complexity.time: O(n log k) for top-k patterns

patternRecognition: Top-K, running median, merge K lists
interviewInsight: State why size-k heap beats full sort for "Min Heap and Max Heap Implementation" when only K matters.
